posts.title: Sophie Davidson Skin | Treatment-journey reactivation

copy.default:
In skin, retention lives across the treatment journey.

A client can start with good intent, make progress, then disappear somewhere between plan, review and the next appointment.

That creates more than one missed booking. It breaks the continuity of the whole journey.

For Sophie Davidson Skin, the 222Emails process focused on finding those breaks, reopening useful skin-plan conversations and giving the client a clear next step.

The commercial result matters.

The system lesson matters more: when the service is a journey, follow-up has to understand the journey too.

posts.mediaAlt: 222Emails client case study for Sophie Davidson Skin showing a 14-day treatment-journey reactivation campaign, re-engaged clients, skin-plan conversations, appointments and attributable potential booking value.
